title: Make the unowned-path ownership hint deterministic and fall back at depth zero
description: Make the unowned-path ownership hint deterministic and fall back at depth zero
acceptance_criteria: `ownership_hint` picks the first declared spec even at depth 0, so `lib/new.ts` can be pointed at `specs/billing/billing.spec.md`. Guard on `depth > 0` and fall back to the generic message.
The first-pass walk returns the first undeclared spec that lists the path, in `read_dir` order. That order isn't deterministic across platforms. Collect every match and sort.
Missing tests: the depth-0 fallback, `src/foo` vs `src/foobar`, a glob entry, and the `_ =>` arm.

answers.constraints: REQ-change-053 ownership is unchanged and only the refusal wording changes
